regime_context: Leadership is concentrated but not one-narrative: AI Infrastructure ranks #1 with a modest 1.56 score and thin breadth (0.125), while US Energy Complex is a close challenger (margin 0.185) with much healthier breadth (0.636). The absolute-trend gate (validated risk-control, gate_helps=true) supports staying-power reads, but cross-sectional rank is display-only. Unscheduled macro-surprise share is elevated (0.75), arguing for humility.
emerging_watch: Watching whether a CONFIRMED handoff from AI Infrastructure (leader) to US Energy Complex (challenger) materializes: the observable is the margin between them widening beyond 0.5 with Energy breadth sustaining at/above 0.6 for 5 consecutive sessions — if instead SMH holds rank #1 with breadth recovering above 0.35, the handoff watch retires.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: The challenger trend-gate leg is the cleanest read here: eligible, durable (0.62), and — critically — broad (breadth 0.636, best among top ranks), which distinguishes it from the AI leader's 0.125 thinness. It is not crowded (z 0.93). This is not a rank-based buy; it is a durability/breadth judgement expressed as a lean.
theses.dissent: Energy is typically a cyclical, macro/geo-driven theme and the momentum score has no forward edge; any OPEC/geopolitics surprise (unscheduled_share 0.75) could reverse it quickly.

falsifier.text: XLE rolls over and trades below its 50-day average for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The leader leg is directional but fragile: it holds rank #1 and is trend-gate eligible, but breadth is a very thin 0.125 — leadership is being carried by few names rather than a cohesive move. That argues for a cautious lean, not a chase; the crowding flag is absent so no size-down override fires, but the concentration itself is the caution.
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional momentum has no forward edge and the thin breadth makes this a potential single-name/idiosyncratic carry rather than a durable theme; if the lead names stall, the whole rank collapses.

falsifier.text: SMH drops below its 20-day average while breadth stays under 0.20 by the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: This is the one crowding caution that lands as an 'avoid' rather than 'overweight': score 1.192 is healthy and durability is intact (0.75), but crowding_z 1.61 is flagged crowded. Per guardrails, crowding is never a fade or short — but given a trend-following, vol-aware allocator, the crowding flag is grounds to not add fresh exposure. Leaning avoid (do not initiate), not underweight.
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge and the trend itself (hurst=trend) is intact; avoiding it may simply miss continued participation if the theme keeps working.

falsifier.text: CIBR's crowding_z falls back below 1.0 while price makes a new 20-day high before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
